rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/badzra bi dā ra na ma dhā ra ṇi/bod skad du/rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ga

tei:div.tei:p: )rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ badzra bi dā ra na ma dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje la bzhugs te// sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rje'i lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas// rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// de nas lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis// rdo rje khro bo las byung ba// rdo rje snying po rab tu smras te/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jil bar byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa/ las thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ gdon thams cad brlag par byed pa/ gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed pa/ rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug pa/ ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ sems can thams cad srung ba/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rmugs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi mthu chen po 'di sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras so// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mashtsaṇḍa badzra pā ṇa ya/ mahā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tadya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ sphu ṭa sphu ṭa/ spho ṭa ya spho ṭa ya/ ghūrṇā ghūrṇā/ ghūrṇā pa ya/ ghūrṇā pa ya/ sarba satwā ni/ bho dha ya/ bho dha ya/ saṃ bho dha ya/

saṃ bho dha ya/ bhrā ma bhrā ma/ saṃ bhrā ma ya/ saṃ bhrā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā ni/ kuṭṭa kuṭṭa/ saṃ kuṭṭa ya/ saṃ kuṭṭa ya/ sarba sha trun/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya/ saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba bidyaṃ badzra badzra/ spho ṭa ya badzra badzra/ ka ṭa badzra badzra/ ma ṭa badzra badzra/ ma tha badzra badzra/ aṭṭa hā sa nī la badzra su badzra ya swā hā/ he phullu/ ni ru phullu/ gṛhṇa kullu/ mi li tsullu/ ku ru kullu/ badzra bi dza yā swā hā/ kī li kī la ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na/ pra mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya badzra bi dā ra ṇa ya swā hā/ tstshindha tstshindha/ bhindha bhindha/ ma hā kī li kī la ya swā hā/ bhandha bhandha/ kro dha badzra kī li kī la ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇḍa kī li kī la ya swā hā/ trā sa ya/ trā sa ya/ badzra kī li kī la ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra/ badzra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badzra pra bhañdza nā ya swā hā/ ma tisthi ra badzra/ shu tisthi ra badzra/ pra tisthi ra badzra/ ma hā badzra/ a pra ti ha ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra/ e hye hi/ shrī ghraṃ badzra dha rā ya swā hā/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba badzra kū la ā warta ya swā hā/ a mu ka mā ra ya phaṭa: na massa manta badzra ṇaṃ/ sarba badzra ku laṃ ma warta ya/ ma hā ba le/ ka ta pa le/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇḍa la ma ye a ti badzra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra na ra na/ a dzi te/ dzwa la dzwa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ting ga le/ da ha da ha/ to dzwa ba ti/ ti li ti li/ bhandha bhandha/ ma hā ba le/ badzra aṃ ku sha dzwa lā ya swā hā/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mashtsaṇṭa badzra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tadya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badzra/ ma tha ma tha badzra/ dhu na dhu na badzra/ da ha da ha badzra/ pa tsa pa tsa badzra/ dha ra dha ra badzra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badzra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badzra/ tstshindha tstshindha badzra/ bhindha bhindha badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ na mashtsaṇḍa badzra kro dha ya/

hu lu hu lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bhandha bhandha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed// rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste// dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan// sems can dbang po nyams pa dang*// tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang*// phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang*// lha rnams rgyab kyi phyogs pa dang*// mdza' sdug skye bo sdang ba dang*// bran bza' la sogs gtses pa dang*// phan tshun mthun pa ma yin dang*// nor 'grib pas ni gnod pa dang*// mya ngan ngal dang gnod pa dang*// 'jigs pa dang ni phongs pa dang*// gza' dang sgyu skar byad stems dang*// mi bzad gdon gyi nyan pa dang*// mya ngan ngal las byung ba yi// rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang*// des ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yin// mdo sde dam pa nyan par gyis// gang dag yid dge sems dang zhing*// gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te// zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba// mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na// mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis// srog chags dag ni thams cad kyi// mi bzad pa yi nad rnams kyang*// de dag thams cad zhi bar blta// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur// sdig pa kun las rnam par thar// nor bu yungs kar dūrba dang*// rin chen rma med tsandan bcas// shel dang rdo rje me tog dang*// chu yi gser ram yang na ni// dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung*// gtsang ma'i gos kyis dkri zhing dgang*// lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam// yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad// rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas ni// rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang bi ma la mi tra dang*/ sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ ye shes rdo rje dang*/ smṛ ti dzñā na la sogs pa'i 'grel pa'i nang nas bton te gzungs shin tu dag pa'o// oṃ/

sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// rdo rje sku yi bkra shis shog /āḥ gsung mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// rdo rje gsung gi bkra shis shog /hūm̐: thugs mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// rdo rje thugs kyi bkra shis shog /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa yis// rdo rje khro bo'i skur bstan pa// rnam par 'joms pa'i bkra shis shog// /
